nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every pure braid $\beta$ on $n + 1$ strands, if $\gamma \beta \gamma^{-1} = \beta^{-1}$ for some pure braid $\gamma$ on $n + 1$ strands, then $\beta = 1$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 11.54: only the trivial pure braid is conjugate to its inverse

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every pure braid $\beta$ on $n + 1$ strands that is conjugate to its inverse inside the pure braid group, that is, $\gamma \beta \gamma^{-1} = \beta^{-1}$ for some pure braid $\gamma$ on $n + 1$ strands, is the identity braid.
nodes.title: Kourovka 11.54: pure braids conjugate to their inverses

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the pure (coloured) braid group $P_{n+1}$ on $n + 1$ strands is the normal closure, in the braid group $B_{n+1}$, of the squares $\sigma_i^2$ of the standard generators $\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n$ of $B_{n+1}$, where $B_{n+1}$ is the Artin group of the Coxeter matrix of type $A_n$.
nodes.title: Pure braid group

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the pure (coloured) braid group $P_{n+1}$ on $n + 1$ strands is the normal closure, in the braid group $B_{n+1}$, of the squares $\sigma_i^2$ of the standard generators $\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_n$ of $B_{n+1}$, where $B_{n+1}$ is the Artin group of the Coxeter matrix of type $A_n$.
nodes.title: Pure braid group

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every integer $k \ge 1$, if pure braids $\alpha$ and $\beta$ on $n + 1$ strands satisfy $\alpha^k = \beta^k$, then $\alpha = \beta$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 11.55: roots in pure braid groups are unique

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every integer $k \ge 1$, if pure braids $\alpha$ and $\beta$ on $n + 1$ strands satisfy $\alpha^k = \beta^k$, then $\alpha = \beta$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 11.55: unique roots in pure braid groups

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
